identity: A two-colour Orzhov control deck that solves the Superfriends problem sideways. The 5-rare/mythic cap allows only two planeswalkers here, so instead of chasing a third the deck buys REDUNDANCY: Serra Paragon rebuys Liliana of the Veil from the graveyard ('cast a permanent spell with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard'), which is the only way in this pool to have a walker answered and get it back. It stabilises behind the deepest removal suite the cube offers in two colours, then wins without ever attacking: nine creatures with defender wall off the ground while Blight Pile drains for X equal to that defender count, Wingmantle Chaplain converts the same wall into a flying board, and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse turns every opposing draw step into 2 life. Urza Assembles the Titans digs for, free-deploys and double-activates the walkers on top of that plan.

restrictions.base_pool: cube_mainboard of dominaria-united---main-set only; every card verified by exact-name match against the working pool cache.
restrictions.common_uncommon_max_2: PASS - no common or uncommon exceeds 2 copies across mainboard + sideboard combined, verified programmatically via cube_search.get_max_copies with a per_rarity policy.
restrictions.rare_mythic_max_1_each: PASS - Urza Assembles the Titans, Liliana of the Veil, Karn Living Legacy, Serra Paragon, Sheoldred the Apocalypse are 1 copy each.
restrictions.rare_mythic_total_max_5: PASS - exactly 5: Urza Assembles the Titans (rare) plus four mythics (Liliana, Karn, Serra Paragon, Sheoldred). Zero rare/mythic cards in the sideboard. Plaza of Heroes and Temporary Lockdown were both available and were both deliberately declined - see count_dependent_verdicts.
restrictions.basics: Plains x7, Swamp x7 - format-supplied, exempt from copy limits.
restrictions.colour_legality: PASS - every nonland card returns a usable mode from effective_cost.best_mode(card, ['W','B'], []). Two sideboard cards print off-colour identities that come only from unpayable kickers: Runic Shot (UW, Kicker {U}) and Tribute to Urborg (BU, Kicker {1}{U}). Both are played in their mono-W and mono-B base modes respectively; neither kicker is counted on anywhere in this build.

mainboard.name: Urza Assembles the Titans
mainboard.oracle_text:
Read ahead (Choose a chapter and start with that many lore counters. Add one after your draw step. Skipped chapters don't trigger. Sacrifice after III.)
I — Scry 4, then you may reveal the top card of your library. If a planeswalker card is revealed this way, put it into your hand.
II — You may put a planeswalker card with mana value 6 or less from your hand onto the battlefield.
III — You may activate the loyalty abilities of planeswalkers you control twice this turn rather than only once.

mainboard.oracle_text:
+1: Create a tapped Powerstone token. (It's an artifact with "{T}: Add {C}. This mana can't be spent to cast a nonartifact spell.")

sideboard.name: Battlefly Swarm
sideboard.oracle_text:
Flying
{B}: This creature gains deathtouch until end of turn.
sideboard.when_to_board: In against any deck with fliers. This is the deck's most important sideboard slot: its 8 mainboard defenders are ALL ground blockers and cannot block a flier at all. A 1-mana flier with '{B}: This creature gains deathtouch until end of turn' trades with any evasive creature in the cube.
sideboard.answers: evasion (51 cards, 20.6% - the cube's largest threat class)

sideboard.name: Knight of Dusk's Shadow
sideboard.oracle_text:
Menace (This creature can't be blocked except by two or more creatures.)
Your opponents can't gain life.
{1}{B}: This creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
sideboard.when_to_board: In against lifegain decks. 'Your opponents can't gain life' shuts off the whole class; note it does NOT hurt this deck's own lifegain (Extinguish the Light, Prayer of Binding, Sheoldred, Serra Paragon) because the clause reads 'Your opponents'.

sideboard.name: Griffin Protector
sideboard.oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever another creature you control enters, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
sideboard.when_to_board: In against fliers, alongside Battlefly Swarm. 'Flying / Whenever another creature you control enters, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn' - a 2/3 flying blocker that grows off every defender and every Bird token; a Wingmantle Chaplain entering into three defenders makes 4 Birds and turns this into a 6/7 for the turn.

sideboard.name: Runic Shot
sideboard.oracle_text:
Kicker {U} (You may pay an additional {U} as you cast this spell.)
Destroy target tapped creature. If this spell was kicked, scry 2.
sideboard.when_to_board: Reduced to a single copy after the Phase 9 grill. 'Destroy target tapped creature' is a SORCERY, so against a wall the opponent's correct line is simply to stop attacking; the only on-demand tap enabler is Clockwork Drawbridge, 1 of 22 mainboard cards. Kept as a 1-of for decks that must keep attacking. Kicker {U} is never payable here.

sideboard.name: Phyrexian Missionary
sideboard.oracle_text:
Kicker {1}{B} (You may pay an additional {1}{B} as you cast this spell.)
Lifelink
When this creature enters, if it was kicked, return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
sideboard.when_to_board: In against removal-heavy decks. 'Kicker {1}{B}... return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand' - both pips are core, so the kicked mode is always live, and it recovers Sheoldred and Wingmantle Chaplain, which at MV 4 sit outside Serra Paragon's 'mana value 3 or less' window. A 2/3 lifelink body at MV 2 in the meantime.
sideboard.answers: decapitation / gas-out on the MV-4 creatures Serra Paragon cannot reach

sideboard.name: Destroy Evil
sideboard.oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Destroy target creature with toughness 4 or greater.
• Destroy target enchantment.
sideboard.when_to_board: Second copy in against enchantment-leaning decks and against opposing Sagas; also answers an opposing Citizen's Arrest or Prayer of Binding holding one of this deck's own permanents.

sideboard.name: Tribute to Urborg
sideboard.oracle_text:
Kicker {1}{U} (You may pay an additional {1}{U} as you cast this spell.)
Target creature gets -2/-2 until end of turn. If this spell was kicked, that creature gets an additional -1/-1 until end of turn for each instant and sorcery card in your graveyard.
sideboard.when_to_board: In against aggro. A {1}{B} instant granting -2/-2 kills most one- and two-drops before the defender wall is assembled. Kicker {1}{U} is never payable here.
